purpose: Per-race dated human sign-off that reward magnitudes and piety pacing felt right in a real play sitting. Companion to PDV_PacingSimLedger.json (machine half of the C-PACING gates). Read by tools/pdv_1_0_endstate_gate.mjs.

rules.stalenessRule: Each sign-off records simLedgerHash (sha256 of PDV_PacingSimLedger.json at sign-off time). A re-tune changes the sim ledger, which flips the sign-off STALE in the end-state burndown until re-observed.
rules.recordingRule: Sign off only after a real sitting on that race, not after a debug-page walk.
